question: How long do I have to dispute a charge on my Fernhollow credit card?
reference_note: Current article KB01-2 says 120 days from the posting date; stale FAQ KB03-1 (last reviewed 2023) says 60 days from the transaction date.
complaint_theme: Problem with a purchase shown on your statement

question: I see two debit card purchases on my account that I never made. What should I do right now?
reference_note: Lock the card in the app, report in the app or call the 24-hour Fraud Line; not responsible if reported within 60 days of the statement.
complaint_theme: Unauthorized transactions or other transaction problem

question: I reported fraud on my checking account. How long until I get my money back?
reference_note: Decision within 10 business days; if more time is needed, temporary credit by the 10th business day and up to 45 days in total.
complaint_theme: Problem with a company's investigation into an existing problem

question: I was tricked into sending $800 with QuickSend to a fake landlord. Will Fernhollow refund it?
reference_note: Usually treated as authorized, not covered; Fernhollow will try to recover from the receiving bank with no guarantee; report to FTC and police.

question: How much is the overdraft fee now?
reference_note: $25 per item, at most 2 per day, none if overdrawn by $10 or less (since April 1, 2026). The archived KB11-1 ($35) must not be used.

question: Can you refund the overdraft fee I was charged last week?
reference_note: Courtesy refund through chat or phone, usually one overdraft fee per 12 months; more reviewed case by case.
complaint_theme: Problem caused by your funds being low

question: Why am I paying $12 a month on my checking account, and how do I stop it?
reference_note: Everyday Checking maintenance fee; waived with $1,500 daily balance, $500 direct deposits, or age under 24.

question: I typed the wrong password too many times and now the app will not let me in. How long is the lock?
reference_note: 30 minutes after 5 failed attempts; or reset immediately with Forgot password.

question: My account was frozen without warning and I need to pay rent. What can I do?
reference_note: Call Account Review; most reviews take 3-10 business days after documents arrive; withdrawals may be blocked. No passage offers emergency access to funds.

question: A check I deposited is on hold. When will I get the money?
reference_note: First $225 next business day, rest within 2 business days; longer holds up to 7 business days in listed cases, with the date given.
complaint_theme: Money was not available when promised

question: Fernhollow reported a late payment on my credit report, but I paid on time. How do I fix this?
reference_note: Dispute with Fernhollow (online form or letter) or with the bureau; include proof; investigation within 30 days; corrections sent to every bureau.

question: A collector from Fernhollow Recovery Services says I owe $2,300, but I do not recognize this debt. What can I do?
reference_note: Send a written dispute within 30 days of the validation notice; collection on the disputed amount stops until proof is mailed.
complaint_theme: Attempts to collect debt not owed

question: I got a letter saying my old Fernhollow credit card debt was sold. Can I still pay Fernhollow directly?
reference_note: No; after the sale Fernhollow cannot accept payments or settle; pay or contact the buyer named in the letter.

question: Why did my monthly mortgage payment go up by $180 this year?
reference_note: Most likely an escrow shortage found in the annual escrow analysis (for example a tax increase); the shortage can be paid at once or spread over 12 months.

question: My escrow account has more money than it needs. Do I get the extra back?
reference_note: Refund check within 30 days of the analysis if the surplus is $50 or more and the loan is current; smaller surplus applied to next year.

question: You charged my escrow for insurance, but I already have homeowners insurance. Why?
reference_note: Lender-placed insurance is bought when proof of coverage is missing; send proof and the charge for covered days is refunded.

question: My father passed away. How do I close his Fernhollow checking account and get the money?
reference_note: No article covers accounts of deceased customers or estates; KB18 covers closing your own account only.

question: Can I skip this month's auto loan payment because a hurricane damaged my home?
reference_note: The knowledge base has no auto loan or disaster relief article; KB32 is about mortgages only.

question: I sent an international wire to the wrong account number. Can you get it back?
reference_note: No article covers recalling or tracing a wire; KB15 lists wire fees only and KB08 is about QuickSend.

question: How long does Fernhollow take to respond to a complaint?
reference_note: Acknowledgment within 2 business days; full response within 15 business days, or a new date with a reason.
complaint_theme: Problem with a company's investigation into an existing problem
